question_summary: Confirm the minimum cover requirement for underground utility trench backfill per Section 31 23 00 and whether the civil inspector can sign off as shown for Pour Sequence 4.
proposed_solution: Allow civil inspector to sign off on the trench backfill cover as shown.
deadline_text: A response within three days would help us stay ahead of the compaction testing.
routing_rationale: The inquiry concerns trench backfill cover per Section 31 23 00 and Civil Detail 6/C-601, which falls under the civil/site scope governed by the Civil EOR.
